title: cc-2.1.260 — a tool stalling and clearing, on the clock alone
description: The harvested 99f96635 session at five clock positions. The TREE NEVER CHANGES — no content arrives after the first frame. Only `now` moves, so every difference between frames is the stall derivation and nothing else. Both levels — the inner Bash and the outer Agent spawn waiting on it — turn amber at 120000 ms of silence and clear together when activity resumes.

steps.label: stalled

steps.label: nudged
steps.what: the user intervened here; 853,293 ms of silence by this frame

steps.label: resumed
